body.x: Uniplatek (CEO Suk Hwan Kang) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7th to 10th (local time) in Las Vegas, USA, under the 'K-Startup Pavilion.'

Uniplatek uses new technology and innovative processes to prevent air pollution and viruses. According to company representatives, it specializes in sterilizing and deodorizing polluted air using nano-photocatalyst technology instead of conventional filter-based methods.

The company stated, "There is an increasing demand for preemptive and preventive air sterilization technologies due to the rising need for a healthy life, a pleasant environment, and safe indoor air following the COVID-19 pandemic. We developed a problem-solving platform solution based on our proprietary composite photocatalyst technology with semiconductor properties to address this. This includes UV photocatalysts capable of sterilization and deodorization, with added fine dust purification capabilities. We have created a filterless sterilization and deodorization composite module, offering an air purification safety solution."

This technology has been patented in the United States and has received international certifications such as FCC certification, EPA manufacturing authorization, European CE certification, and Japan's PSE certification. Furthermore, it demonstrated its prowess as an award-winning technology at CES 2024.

Uniplatek's products provide air sterilization and deodorization functions, with additional features like auxiliary restroom heaters to prevent freezing. The company explained that it developed a photocatalyst platform composite technology for sterilizing and deodorizing air applicable to various pollution environments, ensuring safe and pleasant indoor air quality.

The company particularly emphasized its technology, designed to maintain respiratory health for the elderly, who are more vulnerable. A Uniplatek representative said, "Using our unique deodorization platform technology, we effectively contribute to addressing environmental and respiratory diseases as well as removing odors associated with the elderly."

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
